name: GlocalSaino Booking Calendars displayed by shortcodes
author: glocalsaino

sections.description:
GlocalSaino Booking Calendars displayed by shortcodes turns any page into a booking page for your holiday home, apartment or rural house. Create one calendar per accommodation, paste its shortcode [glocalsaino_booking_calendar id="123"] wherever you want, and guests can check availability, see the total price and send a booking request. You confirm each request once you receive the bank transfer.

Everything is free: no license key, no locked features, no limits on calendars or bookings.

Documentation: installation, every accommodation setting, prices and offers, iCal sync, emails and placeholders, coupons, the bookings panel and FAQ at glocalsaino.com/bookingcalendarsdisplayedbyshortcodes/documentacion.

Accommodations (one calendar each)

  • Capacity: maximum number of guests, shown on the calendar.
  • Check-in and check-out times.
  • House rules shown to the guest — and accepted — before sending the request.
  • Minimum and maximum stay and a booking window (how many months ahead guests can book).

Availability

  • Block days with a visual calendar in the admin: select a day or a range and make it unbookable (or bookable again).
  • Preparation days: automatically block 1, 2… days before and/or after every booking to get the accommodation ready (e.g. 1 day before and after, only 1 day after, 2 days before…).
  • Dates booked by other guests, dates blocked by you and dates imported from other platforms are shown as not available. Pending requests can hold their dates (optional).

Calendar synchronization (iCal)

  • Export: every accommodation has a private iCal address to paste in Airbnb, Booking.com, Vrbo or any platform that accepts iCal links.
  • Import: paste the iCal export links of those platforms; their bookings become unavailable dates here. Imports run automatically (every 1–24 hours) and on demand.

Prices

  • General price per night and an optional weekend price (you choose the weekend nights).
  • Seasons: a different price (and weekend price) for any period.
  • Day prices: set a specific price for any day or range from the admin calendar.
  • Additional guests: price includes N guests; every additional guest adds a cost per night. Example: capacity 8, price for 4 guests and 15 € per additional guest and night.
  • Long-stay discounts: e.g. 10 % for 1 week, 20 % for 2 weeks — any number of rules.
  • Special offers for dates: a percentage off the nights between two dates. Discounts apply to the night price plus the additional-guest cost of each affected night.

Discount coupons

  • Create coupon codes with a percentage or a fixed amount off the total of the stay.
  • Optional conditions: specific accommodations, dates on which the coupon can be used, check-in dates, minimum nights, total uses and uses per guest.
  • Guests apply the code in the booking summary and see the new total before booking. The field only appears when there are active coupons.
  • Uses are counted from pending and confirmed bookings: rejecting or cancelling a booking frees its use.

Guest emails

  • Fully editable emails with placeholders: guest name, dates, check-in/check-out times, number of nights and guests, total price, price breakdown, house rules, bank details, booking reference…
  • Scheduled sending relative to the booking request, its confirmation, the check-in date or the check-out date: the day of the request (payment instructions), one day before arrival, the day of arrival, one day before departure, the day of departure, etc.
  • Rejection and cancellation emails, administrator notification of new requests, email history and “send now” in every booking.

Bookings panel

  • Requests arrive as Pending; you confirm, reject or cancel them. Booking is never automatic.
  • Table of all bookings with filters (status, accommodation, upcoming arrivals, guests staying now, past stays) and search.
  • Follow-up screen for each booking: payment status and amount received, private notes, change of dates or guests with price recalculation, manual price adjustment, emails sent and scheduled.
  • Add bookings received by phone or email by hand.

Payment by bank transfer

  • Configure the account holder, IBAN/account number, bank and SWIFT once (or per accommodation). Guests receive the details and the booking reference to use as the transfer concept. Confirm the booking when the money arrives.

Front end

  • Responsive calendar with 1–3 months side by side, price per night on each available day, and range selection that only allows available dates (respecting preparation days and minimum stay).
  • Summary with the total price (nights + additional guests − discounts) before booking.
  • Guests must be registered and logged in to send a request; if they are not, they log in or register and come back to the same selection.
  • [glocalsaino_my_bookings] lists the bookings of the logged-in guest.

For developers

Actions and filters for add-ons, among them glocalsaino_bcal_booking_created, glocalsaino_bcal_booking_status_changed, glocalsaino_bcal_email_placeholders, glocalsaino_bcal_quote, glocalsaino_bcal_admin_tabs, glocalsaino_bcal_sanitize_config, glocalsaino_bcal_booking_detail_form and glocalsaino_bcal_booking_detail_sidebar. See “For developers” in the plugin documentation.

Privacy

The plugin stores the booking data guests enter (name, email, phone, comments, dates) in your WordPress database to manage their bookings. It does not send data to external services. iCal synchronization only downloads the calendar addresses you configure, and the exported calendar contains dates only, without guest data.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Booking Calendars → Settings and enter your currency and bank account.
  3. Go to Booking Calendars → Add accommodation, fill in the tabs (General, Prices, Offers, Availability, Synchronization, Emails, Payment) and publish it.
  4. Copy the shortcode shown in the edit screen into any page.
  5. Make sure guests can create an account (Settings → General → Anyone can register) or create their accounts yourself.
sections.faq:
Where is the documentation?

At glocalsaino.com/bookingcalendarsdisplayedbyshortcodes/documentacion: installation, every accommodation setting, prices and offers, availability and iCal sync, emails and placeholders, payment, coupons, the bookings panel, settings and more answers.

Are bookings confirmed automatically?

No. Every request is pending until you confirm it, usually after receiving the bank transfer. You can also reject it.

Do pending requests block the dates?

By default yes, so that two guests do not pay for the same nights. You can change it in Settings and you can make unconfirmed requests expire automatically after a number of days.

How do I connect with Airbnb or Booking.com?

In the Synchronization tab of the accommodation: copy the export address into the other platform’s “import calendar” option, and paste the other platform’s “export calendar” address in the import list. Platforms refresh imported calendars on their own schedule (often every few hours).

Scheduled emails arrive late

WordPress runs scheduled tasks when the site receives visits. For exact timing, set up a real cron job on your server that calls wp-cron.php.

Can I show several accommodations on the same page?

Yes, add one shortcode per accommodation.

What happens when I delete the plugin?

Your data is kept unless you check “Delete all calendars, bookings and settings” in Settings before deleting it.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • New: discount coupons (Booking Calendars → Coupons), with percentage or fixed discounts and optional limits by accommodation, dates, minimum nights and number of uses.
  • New email placeholders {coupon_code} and {coupon_discount}.
  • Coupons can also be applied to bookings added or edited by the administrator.

1.0.1

  • Guests enter first name, last name and second last name (optional) in separate fields. Existing bookings are migrated automatically.
  • New email placeholders {guest_first_name} and {guest_last_name}.
  • The guest’s name is saved in their user profile when it was empty.

1.0.0

  • First release.
